name: Retry count far above maximum (API contract)
description: Protocol-level check: a request with retry_count=10 (far above max_retry_count=3) is rejected by the circuit breaker with HTTP 429, DONT_RETRY, confidence exactly 1.0, and the transaction_id echoed back.

mock_bank_state.note: Bank state is irrelevant - the request is short-circuited before the agent runs.

request.failure_reason: Simulated upstream failure for E2E testing

expected_response.explanation: Max retry limit reached. The transaction has already been retried 10 times, exceeding the configured maximum (max_retry_count=3). No further retries will be attempted.

api_requests.notes: Deterministic short-circuit response; no LLM involvement. Confidence exactly 1.0; transaction_id echoed.
